title: Practice 5: Running, swimming, climbing, crawling, dragging

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Вы когда-нибудь ___ (кататься — to roll (oneself; impf., past pl.)) на гидроцикле?
exercises.why: **катались** — past tense (plural) of кататься: many-directions verb (one direction: катиться).
exercises.prompt: Have you ever ridden a jet ski?

exercises.q: Ты когда-нибудь ___ (кататься — to roll (oneself; impf., past m. sg.)) на гидроцикле?
exercises.why: **катался** — past tense (masculine) of кататься: many-directions verb (one direction: катиться).
exercises.prompt: Have you ever ridden a jet ski?

exercises.q: Мы пустили своих жуков ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., inf.) наперегонки.
exercises.why: **бежать** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Как быстро ты ___ (бегать — to run, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)!
exercises.why: **бегаешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).

exercises.q: Футболист устал ___ (бегать — to run, there and back or in general; impf., inf.).
exercises.why: **бегать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.prompt: The soccer player has got tired of running.

exercises.q: Хорошая кожа будет ___ (носиться — to carry on foot (oneself; impf., inf.)) годы.
exercises.why: **носиться** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: нестись).
exercises.prompt: Good leather will wear for years.

exercises.q: Почему собаки ___ (гоняться — to drive, chase (oneself; impf., pres. 3rd pl.)) за белками?
exercises.why: **гоняются** — present tense (3rd person plural) of гоняться: many-directions verb (one direction: гнаться).

exercises.q: The Ice Age was a time when woolly mammoths roamed the Earth.
exercises.why: **бродили** — past tense (plural) of бродить: many-directions verb (one direction: брести).
exercises.ru: Ледниковый период был временем, когда по Земле ___ волосатые мамонты.

exercises.q: Ребёнок начал ___ (ползать — to crawl, there and back or in general; impf., inf.).
exercises.why: **ползать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: ползти).

exercises.q: Вчера наши курицы обильно ___ (нестись — to carry on foot (oneself; impf., past pl.)).
exercises.why: **неслись** — past tense (plural) of нестись: one-direction verb (many directions: носиться).
exercises.prompt: Yesterday our hens laid a lot of eggs.

exercises.q: Когда я ___ (бегать — to run, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st sg.), я потею.
exercises.why: **бегаю** — present tense (1st person singular) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.prompt: When I run, I get sweaty.

exercises.q: Кэн должен ___ (бегать — to run, there and back or in general; impf., inf.) быстро.
exercises.why: **бегать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).

exercises.q: Дети ___ (катать — to roll, there and back or in general; impf., past pl.) снежный ком.
exercises.why: **катали** — past tense (plural) of катать: many-directions verb (one direction: катить).
exercises.prompt: The children were rolling a big snowball.

exercises.q: Кто ___ (лазить — to climb, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) в мою сумку?
exercises.why: **лазил** — past tense (masculine) of лазить: many-directions verb (one direction: лезть).

exercises.q: По озеру ___ (плыть — to swim, float, sail, one way; impf., past f. sg.) маленькая лодочка.
exercises.why: **плыла** — past tense (feminine) of плыть: one-direction verb (many directions: плавать).
exercises.prompt: Across the lake sailed a little boat.

exercises.q: Моя собака любит ___ (гоняться — to drive, chase (oneself; impf., inf.)) за белками.
exercises.why: **гоняться** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: гнаться).

exercises.q: Its massive gravity well tugs many asteroids from the outer belt inwards.
exercises.why: **тащит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of тащить: one-direction verb (many directions: таскать).
exercises.ru: Его огромная гравитация ___ много астероидов из внешнего пояса вовнутрь.

exercises.q: Его глаза ___ (бегать — to run, there and back or in general; impf., past pl.) туда-сюда.
exercises.why: **бегали** — past tense (plural) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.prompt: His eyes went to and fro.

exercises.q: Мужчины ___ (ползать — to crawl, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.) у её ног.
exercises.why: **ползают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ползать: many-directions verb (one direction: ползти).

exercises.q: Белки очень хорошо ___ (лазать — to climb, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **лазают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of лазать: many-directions verb (one direction: лезть).
